title: Welcoming Coconut Crunch Thai Herbal Moo Ping
description: A Thai-style moo ping dish featuring a crispy coconut crust, energizing herbs, and a flavorful sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and chili flakes (if using). Blend until you have a smooth paste.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Thread pork slices onto skewers, if desired.
Season the pork with fish sauce, brown sugar, and palm sugar. Grill the pork for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the grilled pork to a plate and brush with a mixture of coconut flakes and water until evenly coated.
In a small saucepan, combine the blended herb paste, water, and lime juice. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Serve the grilled pork skewers with the coconut-crusted top and spoon the aromatic sauce alongside.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
